sourceText: User asked to analyze and implement the Proof-or-Stop agent-drivability optimization roadmap, agreed to a 7 milestone plan, requested the decision doc be updated, opened story B-90d6, then explicitly required the INIT gate guidance, story-level scope-plan dispatch blocker, and checklist_add milestone-ledger sync hint be fixed in this same story so future agents do not rediscover the failures.
normalizedOutcome: The story delivers M0-M1 INIT drivability routing, the minimal story-level lattice-review-scope-plan dispatch unblocker, and checklist_add ledger-sync guidance, while preserving reviewer-written evidence and read-only milestone_status semantics.
acceptanceClaim: A ledger-backed story can show accurate milestone rows for B-90d6, INIT guidance points to init_preflight before INIT_CHECK, story-level scope-plan reviewer dispatch returns a scope_check_save-oriented prompt, and checklist_add warns about milestone_ledger_add when a ledger-backed story receives new checklist work.
